# Banana

> Banana is a daily planner for Google calendars on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

## Product

- [Banana](https://bananatheapp.com/index.md): Plan across Google calendars with Banana. See events, reminders, routines, weather and travel time together on iPhone, iPad and Apple silicon Mac.
- [Google Calendar planner for multiple accounts](https://bananatheapp.com/calendar/index.md): Plan across Google accounts with Apple Reminders, travel time and private Busy blocks on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

## Guides

- [Calendar guides](https://bananatheapp.com/guides/index.md): Step-by-step guides to planning across Google calendars with Banana.
- [Block time across Google calendars](https://bananatheapp.com/guides/how-busy-blocks-work/index.md): Keep work and personal time from overlapping. Learn what a Banana Busy block shares, what stays on the original event, and how Google sharing permissions matter.

## Comparisons

- [Compare calendar apps](https://bananatheapp.com/compare/index.md): Compare calendar providers, sharing controls and prices with Banana Calendar.
- [Banana vs CalendarBridge](https://bananatheapp.com/compare/banana-vs-calendarbridge/index.md): Compare Banana’s Google Calendar planner with CalendarBridge Basic for cross-calendar availability, event detail controls and scheduling pages.
- [Banana vs Calendly](https://bananatheapp.com/compare/banana-vs-calendly/index.md): Compare Banana and Calendly for personal booking links, calendar availability and team routing. See which fits your calendar, how booking works and what each costs.
- [Banana vs Fantastical](https://bananatheapp.com/compare/banana-vs-fantastical/index.md): Compare Banana and Fantastical for Apple calendar planning, account support and personal scheduling. See which fits your calendar, how booking works and what each costs.
- [Banana vs Google Calendar](https://bananatheapp.com/compare/banana-vs-google-calendar/index.md): Compare Banana and Google Calendar for Google accounts, reminders and appointment schedules. See which fits your calendar, how booking works and what each costs.
- [Banana vs Morgen](https://bananatheapp.com/compare/banana-vs-morgen/index.md): Compare Banana and Morgen for time blocking, routines and task planning. See which fits your calendar, how booking works and what each costs.
- [Banana vs Notion Calendar](https://bananatheapp.com/compare/banana-vs-notion-calendar/index.md): Compare Banana and Notion Calendar for Google calendars, project deadlines and sharing availability. See which fits your calendar, how booking works and what each costs.
- [Banana vs OneCal](https://bananatheapp.com/compare/banana-vs-onecal/index.md): Compare Banana and OneCal for booking links, calendar sync, event editing and daily planning. See what Banana includes for free and when OneCal Starter fits.
- [Banana vs Reclaim](https://bananatheapp.com/compare/banana-vs-reclaim/index.md): Compare Banana and Reclaim for protecting time, booking meetings and automatic scheduling. See which fits your calendar, how booking works and what each costs.
- [Banana vs Sunsama](https://bananatheapp.com/compare/banana-vs-sunsama/index.md): Compare Banana and Sunsama for guided daily planning, task estimates and calendar time blocks. See which fits your calendar, how booking works and what each costs.
- [Banana vs Vimcal](https://bananatheapp.com/compare/banana-vs-vimcal/index.md): Compare Banana and Vimcal for sharing available times and coordinating meetings across time zones. See which fits your calendar, how booking works and what each costs.

## Engineering

- [Banana blog](https://bananatheapp.com/blog/index.md): Engineering notes from the Banana team on calendar rendering, performance testing, and building a native daily planning app.
- [15 ms to 2.3 ms: an AI-driven hill climb on our calendar renderer](https://bananatheapp.com/blog/optimizing-calendar-rendering-with-ai/index.md): 36,500 events on an iPhone 14 Pro. Replacing the full-day view tree with reusable cells took Week scrolling from 15 ms to 2.3 ms of work per update and cut day preparation by 44%. What the agent changed, what we measured on the device, and what is still slow.
